What Does a Whole-House Renovation Cost in North Vancouver in 2026?

Most North Vancouver homeowners spend between $90,000 and $380,000 on a full-house renovation in 2026. The final number depends on three factors: your home's square footage, the age of the building, and how many rooms you touch. A typical 1,800–2,200 sq ft North Vancouver house renovated to a mid-range standard costs roughly $175,000–$280,000 all-in.

Reno Stars has completed whole-house renovations across North Vancouver, from post-war ranches in Pemberton Heights to contemporary townhouses near Lynn Valley. Every project starts with a detailed line-item estimate — no hidden fees, no surprise add-ons after signing.

2026 Cost Breakdown by Project Type

Renovation TypeNorth Van Typical RangeWhat It Covers
Full-house gut renovation$175–$280/sq ftAll rooms, new electrical, plumbing, drywall, flooring, paint
Whole-house with layout changes$200–$350/sq ftEverything above plus removing or adding walls, structural work
Whole-house with landscaping$220–$380/sq ftInterior plus exterior, deck, fence, driveway, drainage
Bathroom updates only$18,000–$45,000Full bathroom remodel
Kitchen renovation$35,000–$85,000New cabinets, countertops, appliances, lighting

These ranges reflect 2026 material and labour costs in North Vancouver, based on Reno Stars' actual project records.

How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take in North Vancouver?

A full-house renovation in North Vancouver typically runs 4 to 9 months from permit approval to final walk-through. The main phases are:

  • Design and estimating: 4–8 weeks
  • Permit application: 3–6 weeks
  • Demolition: 1–2 weeks
  • Framing, electrical, plumbing rough-in: 3–5 weeks
  • Insulation, drywall: 2–3 weeks
  • Tiling, flooring, millwork installation: 3–6 weeks
  • Paint, trim, final fixtures: 2–3 weeks
  • Final inspection and punch list: 1–2 weeks

North Vancouver homes built before 1990 may contain asbestos in floor tiles or pipe insulation. Reno Stars arranges mandatory asbestos testing before demolition — budget an additional $1,500–$4,000 if remediation is required.

North Vancouver Permit Requirements for Whole-House Renovation

Most whole-house renovations in the District of North Vancouver require a building permit. Structural changes, electrical or plumbing alterations, or changes to the building footprint definitely require one. Cosmetic renovations like paint, flooring, and cabinet refinishing typically do not.

  • Building permit (structural changes)
  • Electrical permit (new circuits, panel upgrades)
  • Plumbing permit (gas fitting, water line changes)
  • Heritage review (if on the North Vancouver Heritage Inventory)

Reno Stars manages the full permit application process. Homeowners receive the permit number before any demolition begins.

FAQ — Whole-House Renovation Costs in North Vancouver

What is the average cost per square foot for a whole-house renovation in North Vancouver?

In 2026, North Vancouver whole-house renovations range from $175 to $380 per square foot depending on scope and finish level. A standard mid-range renovation typically costs $175–$280/sq ft; a high-end custom project with structural changes runs $200–$350/sq ft.

Does North Vancouver require a permit for a whole-house renovation?

Yes. Any whole-house renovation that alters structure, electrical, plumbing, or the building footprint requires a building permit from the District of North Vancouver. Reno Stars handles the full application.

How long does a whole-house renovation take in North Vancouver?

A typical whole-house renovation in North Vancouver takes 4 to 9 months from permit approval to final walk-through, depending on project complexity.

North Vancouver 全屋裝修 2026 年費用是多少？

2026 年 North Vancouver 全屋裝修費用約為 $90,000 至 $380,000，最終造價取決於三個要素：房屋面積、樓齡及工程範圍。1,800 至 2,200 平方呎的中檔標準全屋裝修，總費約為 $175,000 至 $280,000。

聚星裝修已在 North Vancouver 完成多個全屋裝修項目，包括 Pemberton Heights 的老宅及 Lynn Valley 附近的現代城市屋。每個項目均以詳細逐項報價單為起點——杜絕隱藏費用，簽約後絕無突然加價。

2026 年各類工程造價明細

工程類型North Vancouver 參考價位涵蓋範圍
全屋基礎裝修$175–$280/平方呎全屋水電、牆面、瓷磚，油漆
全屋連間隔改動$200–$350/平方呎上述項目＋拆牆／加牆結構工程
全屋連園景$220–$380/平方呎室內＋陽台、圍欄、車道、排水
浴室翻新$18,000–$45,000全浴室裝修
廚房裝修$35,000–$85,000新櫥櫃、枱面、電器、燈具

以上價位反映 2026 年 North Vancouver 材料及人工成本，數據來自聚星裝修實際工程記錄。

North Vancouver 全屋裝修需要多長時間？

North Vancouver 全屋裝修一般需時 4 至 9 個月，由許可證獲批至最終驗收。主要階段如下：

  • 設計及報價：4–8 週
  • 許可證申請：3–6 週
  • 拆遷：1–2 週
  • 框架、水電初步工程：3–5 週
  • 隔熱、吊頂：2–3 週
  • 瓷磚、地板、木工安裝：3–6 週
  • 油漆、踢腳線、衛浴安裝：2–3 週
  • 最終驗收及整改：1–2 週

1990 年前建成的 North Vancouver 房屋可能含有石棉。聚星裝修在拆遷前安排強制石棉檢測，如需處理，預算額外 $1,500 至 $4,000。

North Vancouver 全屋裝修許可證要求

North Vancouver 區大部分全屋裝修需要 建築許可證。涉及結構、水電改動或建築佔地面積變化的工程必然需要許可證。純裝飾性工程通常不需要。

  • 建築許可證（結構改動）
  • 電工許可證（新電路、配電箱升級）
  • 水管許可證（煤氣管道、供水管改動）
  • 文物評估（如房屋列於文物清單）

聚星裝修代為處理全部許可證申請，業主在動工前即可獲取許可證編號。

常見問題——North Vancouver 全屋裝修費用

North Vancouver 全屋裝修每平方呎平均造價是多少？

2026 年 North Vancouver 全屋裝修每平方呎造價約為 $175 至 $380，視乎工程範圍及選材檔次。中檔標準翻新通常為 $175–$280/平方呎；含結構改動的高端訂製工程為 $200–$350/平方呎。

North Vancouver 全屋裝修需要許可證嗎？

需要。任何涉及結構、水電改動或建築佔地面積變化的全屋裝修均需向 North Vancouver 區政府申請建築許可證。聚星裝修代為處理申請流程。

North Vancouver 全屋裝修需要多長時間？

North Vancouver 全屋裝修一般需時 4 至 9 個月，由許可證獲批至最終驗收，視乎工程複雜程度及所需工種數量。
